marketLayer.title: US Big Tech AI Infrastructure Expenditure & Semiconductor Sector Momentum
marketLayer.fact: Major US tech giants reported a 35% year-over-year increase in capital expenditure dedicated to AI data centers and high-performance computing hardware during recent quarterly disclosures.
marketLayer.inference: Upstream semiconductor equipment vendors and cloud infrastructure hardware suppliers will likely sustain robust revenue growth through H2 2026.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization pace of enterprise AI software applications failing to justify ongoing infrastructure investment levels.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet Platform Sector & Mainland Retail Consumption
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index fluctuated near key technical support as major e-commerce platforms initiated aggressive promotional subsidies in tandem with expanded domestic trade-in stimulus policies.
marketLayer.inference: Operating margins for top-tier e-commerce operators may experience short-term compression, though overall GMV volume growth could buffer gross profit impact.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: The duration of local fiscal subsidy programs and competitive intensity among domestic logistics operators.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Trajectory & Cross-Border Capital Allocation
marketLayer.fact: US core inflation metrics aligned with market consensus at 2.6% year-over-year, reinforcing trader expectations for an impending interest rate cut by the Federal Reserve.
marketLayer.inference: Narrowing interest rate differentials between US dollar yields and Hong Kong dollar assets are expected to support liquidity inflows into HK-listed equities and rate-sensitive dividend yield plays.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential upside surprises in upcoming US non-farm payroll employment data or persistent service-sector inflation.
